description: This test specification file uses Playwright to define automated UI tests for the AI Chatbot application 'VizAI Assistant'. It contains two main test cases: one verifying app reachability and chat UI availability, and another testing basic chat interaction including message sending and response checking.

methods.name: gotoAppRoot
methods.description: Navigates the page to the root of the application.

methods.name: openFloatingChatIfPresent
methods.description: Checks if a floating chat interface is present on the page and opens it if possible.

methods.name: expectChatHeaderVisible
methods.description: Verifies that the chat header for the VizAI assistant is visible on the page.

methods.name: sendChatMessage
methods.description: Sends a specified message in the chat interface.

ctags.name: assistantApology
ctags.pattern: /^    const assistantApology = page.getByText(\/i apologize, but i encountered an error\/i);$/

ctags.name: isLogin
ctags.pattern: /^    const isLogin = await page.getByRole('heading', { name: \/sign in|login\/i }).isVisible().ca/

ctags.name: msg
ctags.pattern: /^    const msg = 'Show me unusual behavior this week';$/
